label: Aperture
help: Opaque flat screen with a centred slit, generated from these sizes. It lies in the entity's local XY plane with its front face toward +Z; the slit runs along local Y and opens across local X. Its long edges are knife edges.

properties.label: Opening
properties.help: Width of the slit across local X; zero closes it. Must be less than Screen width.

properties.label: Slit length
properties.help: Length of the slit along local Y; at most Screen height.

properties.label: Screen width
properties.help: Extent of the screen across the slit, along local X.

properties.label: Screen height
properties.help: Extent of the screen along the slit, along local Y.

properties.label: Reflectance R
properties.help: Linear Lambertian reflectance of the screen; zero absorbs all light, like an ideal knife-edge screen.

properties.label: Reflectance G
properties.help: Linear Lambertian reflectance of the screen; zero absorbs all light, like an ideal knife-edge screen.

properties.label: Reflectance B
properties.help: Linear Lambertian reflectance of the screen; zero absorbs all light, like an ideal knife-edge screen.
